verdicts.reason: A keeps a logical left-to-right flow (headline → copy → CTA), but the product can shrinks to an unreadable orange sliver, the 'WEEKEND ONLY' eyebrow is cut off from the headline and parked over the legal text at the far right, and the legal text is tiny and cramped. B keeps the can and the peach circle better, but it puts the CTA first: 'Shop Sale' is jammed against the left canvas edge ahead of the headline, the eyebrow is separated from '20% off', and the legal text is squeezed into a tiny, crowded block at the right edge. B's reading order is broken in the more serious way.
